customer: Hi there, I'm a night-shift nurse here in Dunmore and I'm planning to sell you my hatchback, which still has a loan on it. Could you tell me how I'd actually get paid once everything's signed, and whether I can stop my car payments right away? Thank you so much!
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Once the paperwork is signed, you can choose a bank draft at the store, direct deposit (1 to 3 business days), or a check mailed to your address (5 to 7 business days). Since there's a loan on your hatchback, we send the payoff to your lender within 2 business days, and you receive whatever amount is left over. Please keep making your loan payments until your lender confirms the payoff; our article "Should I keep making loan payments?" covers this too.
